description: Libro Registro Solares is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Valencia. Conté detalls sobre els solars registrarts a València, indicat la seua locació, surface, characteristics legal and administrative, així com la seua referència cadastral. Font: Geoportal Conjunt de dades d'Alt Valor: Geospatial Dades. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Valencia. The portal shows the English title as "Solar Register Book" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Valencia. Its keywords include Cadastral plots, sòl, Parcelas catastrales, direcciones, floor, addresses. The listing shows 5 download or service links in KMZ, GEO%2BJSON, JSON, HTML. The listing shows 2026-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
